_readme: MAVERICKS -- the reef off Pillar Point, Half Moon Bay, California (2026-10-19, the rolling-wave
work; Mark: a place known for big barrel waves, with public data to pull from). Everything here
is the harvested place's (data/places/mavericks.json, harvest place --place mavericks): the bed
is NOAA's ninth-arc CUDEM, four 2022v1 tiles (n37x50/n37x75 x w122x50/w122x75, NAVD88 metres)
named below as a height source and composed at 13.7 m into data/bathy/mavericks.*; the tide
stations are Pillar Point Harbor's (9414131) and three more within 40 km; the currents are the
Bay's eight stations and buoy 46237's ADCP (none stand at the point: the jet is off); the sea
state is the GFS-Wave node off the point with buoys 46012 (Half Moon Bay) and 46237 (SF Bar).
The solver's domain is the harvested box, no river. The swell is set below: Hs 5 m, Tp 17 s from
290, the winter WNW groundswell the reef stands up -- the sea state's own forecast is the day's.
The world's anchor is the point's tip; x east, z north, metres. The break lies 400 m WSW of it,
over the reef that rises from 20 m to 5 m in a few hundred metres (the bowl at about
37.4915 N 122.5035 W). Views: `bowl` from 6 m on the shoulder looking WSW into the incoming peak;
`lineup_high` from 60 m over the lineup; `point` from the bluff of Pillar Point, the classic
photograph; `reef_high` from 250 m, the reef's shape in the colour of the water.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/mavericks.json

views.name: bowl
views._at: 6 m over the shoulder, 300 m SW of the point, looking WSW into the peak

views.name: lineup_high
views._at: 60 m over the lineup, looking SW down onto the bowl

views.name: point
views._at: the bluff of Pillar Point, 30 m up, the classic photograph toward the break

views.name: reef_high
views._at: 350 m over the harbour mouth, looking SW over the point onto the reef: its ramp from 20 m to 5 m in the colour of the water
